segments.text: Tsukuyo is a second-year student and Asuza's best friend (and neighbour). She is also Madoka's junior and later became friends with Arisa and Makoto (thanks to his culinary talents, whom she also finds a great catch).

Tsukuyo is a genius girl with incredible talent in art, she herself wants to go down this path, as she has no interest in anything else. A bit of an airhead, but overall she's very soft. Although Tsukuyo is a cutie with a beautiful body, she is completely clueless about fashion (and everything that isn't related to arts). She isn't good at dealing with strangers either. When she starts chatting about art-related topics, there will be no end. Once she begins painting, she will become so immersed that she will ignore everything else around.

Tsukuyo can't take care herself; she doesn't know how to do any kinds of household chores or even do her homework. For that reason, she heavily relies on Azusa, who knows how to do everything. Because of this strange relationship, people tend to see them as sisters of whom Tsukuyo is the youngest.

Tsukuyo is a little jealous of the "kind" friendly relationship between Makoto and Arisa because, in her case, she finds Azusa a little scary sometimes. She is also not the type who gets angry at people, even if they criticize her meanly; however, she gets angry at anyone who attacks those she loves.
Her favorite artistic fields are drawing and painting.
During the game, Tsukuyo passes her second year and moves to the next grade (third year).

Tsukuyo doesn't really try to be pretty, even if she is very beautiful naturally. However, in her route, she realizes that her lack of coquetry is a very bad point for her and she asks Azusa to help her to be more girly and stylish.
学年きっての天才児。美術の才能に優れ、本人もその道に進もうと思っている（というよりも他の事に興味がない）ちょっと天然系のゆるふわ美人。
実際、見た目も可愛くスタイルも良いのだけど「自分を着飾る」ことに無頓着。
また、やっかみを受けることもあり見知らぬ相手は苦手。
ただし芸術関係の話になると警戒心はなりを潜め、饒舌になる事も。
絵を描き始めると、それに没頭して周りが見えなくなるのが玉にキズ。

「わたし、浅間くんの作る物、好きだよ」

Azusa is a second-year student and a close friend (and neighbor) of Tsukuyo's. She has a very strict temperament, even making the "poor" Madoka tremble around her. At their first meeting, she was be quite cold towards Makoto, whom she thought was a pervert. However, she was very sweet and kind to Arisa, which shows that she is not a woman with a heart of stone.

Azusa is an honors student who gets above average grades in every subject, and works very hard. However, Azusa has no particular talents, whether it's in art or technology; in other words, she is ordinary and completely normal. Although she is jealous of Tsukuyo's talent and skills, but because she worries about her airheaded side, she is constantly looking after her. The relationship between the two is that of very close friends.
When someone says something that bothers her, she tends to pinch their cheeks.

Azusa is terrified of gaining weight and monitors her physical appearance strictly. As soon as she finds that her belly starts to become flaccid, she panics and no longer dares to put herself in a bathing suit; in other words, she is constantly on a diet.
Every year, she offers Tsukuyo some chocolate cakes because she knows that her friend loves sweets.
Her favorite artistic fields are drawing and wood carving.
During the game, Azusa passes her second year and moves to the next grade (third year).

She is the object of sexual fantasies of many boys in her school. Indeed, Azusa is very popular with men, in high school and even outside, not for her character but because she is very attractive, being even seen as a sex symbol. It sometimes causes her great problems...
優等生。ほぼ全ての教科で平均以上の成績をとっており、努力で詰められる所は詰める理詰めタイプ。
ただし特筆するような才能は無く、美術も技術面での評価は高いが才能面ではごくごく平凡。方向性としては芸術家というよりも職人タイプ。
月夜の才能に嫉妬はあるものの、月夜の緩さが心配で面倒を見たりしている内に、親友と言える間柄になっていた。
それに加え、まどかの面倒も何だかんだと言いながら見ている。
ある意味主人公と「同族」

「そ、そんな……え、エッチ！ スケベ、変態！　なんて事させようとするのよ！」
Madoka is a third-year student and Youta's classmate. She is also the upperclassman of and friends with Asuza, Tsukuyo, Makoto and Arisa.

Madoka spends most of her time in the workshop because it has all the computer equipment she needs. She often spends her nights there, sleeping in her underwear (or completely naked) in a sleeping bag and uses the showers in the gym to wash herself.

She finds that her body does not look mature when comparing to her underclassmen. Because of this, she lacks a little confidence in her femininity, but that doesn't prevent her from using her charms to tease Makoto or bothering her friends by making perverse allusions.

Madoka is the kind of girl who can talk about anything and everything with anyone. She doesn't mind talking about sex with Makoto, for example, when they are just friends because it's something that "everyone wants to do with the opposite sex but nobody dares to talk about because of the embarrassment". However, she doesn't want the conversation to fall into the most total perversity, and that's why she refuses to talk about it with Youta or the other boys...
Her favorite artistic fields are everything related to computer graphics and audiovisuals.
During the game, Madoka graduates and started looking for work in computer graphics and audiovisuals and found a job for a studio based in Los Angeles (USA).

Madoka served as a model for her senpais (only girls) when she was a first year for nude photos. She still has a book containing all these photos but keeps its existence a secret because she is afraid of being pulled up by Asuza. She also usually goes to the infirmary to relieve her sexual urges when she stays at school for the night.
Madoka is mentioned in Ai Kiss 2 as one of the famous graduate.
主人公たちの先輩。月夜程「才能に浸っていない」天才。
理屈と感覚のハイブリッドであり、「自分以上の天才がいる」事や、「運も必要」である事などに気づいている。
色んな才能、素養があり、色々と好きにやっている感じ。
その辺の集大成として、卒業前にショートムービーを作ろうとしている。
「猫みたい」な先輩で、何かにつけて「緩い」生き物。
のらりくらりぬるぬると生きており、大抵のことは飲み込んで受け流している。
みんなの作業スペースの一角が彼女の「巣」になっていて、寝袋やら何やらが積んであり、時々そこにくるまって寝てる。

Makoto's underclassman who is 1/4 of Scandinavian descent. She knows Makoto from church, and for whatever reason she came to a Japanese art academy. She works as a waitress with Makoto at Kyouko's café: the Modulor.

Inconsistent with age and height, although she appears to be mature and reliable, she is actually introverted and unsociable. Because she desperately wants to hide it, when in class she feels isolated. She works at the same place as Makoto, and because she can talk to him normally, she trusts him.
Later, thanks to Makoto, she becomes friends with Tsukuyo, Asuza and Madoka.
Arisa seems to be able to speak at least five languages: Finnish, Swedish and Japanese as her mother tongues as well as French and English.
Arisa seems to have been in love with Makoto for a very long time, however only Kyouko seems to have noticed it, at first.

Arisa does not really have a favorite artistic field as she mainly helps her Senpais to finish their work and she is very interested in everything she does. However, we learn later that Arisa seems to be more attracted to painting.
During the game, Arisa passes her first year and moves to the next grade (second year). At the end of the game, she passes her second year and moves in third year.

Even though Arisa is of a shy temperament, she remains a very strong woman, a true iron lady who does not let herself get on her feet when someone tries to intimidate her, to such an extent that she scares even those who have tried to intimidate her.
Hijiri is the first friend that Arisa made by her own.

Although she is not yet of legal drinking age, Arisa drinks alcohol regularly and she can handle it very well. However, she once had too much drunk and ended up completely drunk and slumped on the floor. This story still makes Kyouko and Makoto laugh a lot.
Arisa seems to masturbate using as a fragrant stimulant the tissues she found in Makoto's trash can and which were used for the same purpose.

The fact that Arisa is a perfect Finnish-Swedish bilingual can give us a clue about her region of origin in Finland (in one of the bilingual regions of the south-west of the country), her ability to speak French also gives us an additional clue, suggesting that she must come from the region of Uusimaa.
Arisa is mentioned in Ai Kiss 2 as being one of the famous graduate.

その為クラスでは若干孤立気味。

「ま、真サン！　助けてください！」

Makoto is a second-year student and Kyouko's nephew and Arisa's first cousin. He studies in a high school specialized in Arts: "2D" Arts (painting, drawing,...), "3D" Arts (sculpture, model making,...) and "Computer" Arts (computer graphics, audiovisual,...). He is very friendly with his senpai, Youta. Towards the end of his second year, Makoto met Tsukuyo, Asuza and Madoka-senpai in the workshop that serves as their club room and eventually joined them.

After a while, Makoto befriended the three young women and introduced them to Arisa so that they could become friends and then take them to his aunt's café, named Modulor, where he introduced them to his talents as a cook and pastry chef.

His aunt Kyouko plans to give him his coffee once he will graduates to take over the family business. However, Makoto does not want to make a career in the restoration and he is done to gives everything to succeed in the path in which he has committed.
His favorite artistic fields are drawing and wood carving.
During the game, Makoto passes his second year and moves to the next grade (third year).
Makoto worries a lot about Arisa because he is afraid that she will be alone again when him, Azusa and Tsukuyo will graduate.

Makoto is nice to everyone, even with Hijiri who has challenged Tsukuyo for the first place of the great art exhibition of the school. His kindness makes people come to appreciate him easily and Hijiri tries to become his friend (not openly because of her pride). The negative side of this personality trait is that his girlfriend thinks that Makoto is cheating on her with Hijiri (because they are often together). However, everyone has confidence in Makoto, and this suspicion of adultery doesn't stay long in the minds.
主人公。専門的に見れば凡人。元々手先が器用で、粘土細工やプラモなどが好きだった少年。
それが周りから褒められ、美術系の学園へ進む。
しかしそういった「好きで上手い」程度は当たり前の世界の中では極めて平凡で「好きだけで出来るもんじゃないのでは」という思いを抱き始めている。
ただ腐ったりはせず、基本は前向きな善人。

ノリは良いのだがそれ以上に人づきあいや面倒見が良く、損をしているように見える。

A first-year student and a heroine in the PSV version who hates hard work as she is a natural-born genius. She claims to be Tsukuyo's fatal rival.
Her favorite artistic fields are drawing and painting.
Hijiri enters high school during the game, after the former third years (Madoka and Youta) have graduated. At the end of the game, she passes her first year and moves in second year.

Barely entered the first year, Hijiri has challenged Tsukuyo for the first place of the great art exhibition of the school, putting Tsukuyo in a funny panic state because she doesn't like confrontation. She is a real fan of Tsukuyo's work and dreams that one day she will be able to surpass her.

She also gives drawing lessons to Makoto so that he can improve. She's also one of the few rare students to serve as a model for nude drawings without being embarrassed. Thus, she stripped herself in front of Makoto to be draw, even forcing him to touch her chest and butt so that he could understand the feel and texture of the material he has to draw.
Later, Hijiri become the first friend that Arisa made by her own.
Hijiri is mentioned in Ai Kiss as one of the famous students of the school after she has graduated

Makoto's residence's landlady, and as for blood relations, she is his aunt and is also related to Arisa, who is her cousin's daughter. She owns a coffee shop named Modulor.
Kyouko always watches over her two "lambs" and knows her nephew as if she were his mother.
Some time after graduating from high school, Kyouko went on a "world tour" to learn more about cooking, she even went to Finland.

From what she says (when she's a little drunk), she always had a huge success with men, having received invitations and premium tickets to access as a VIP to various places like amusement parks, water parks or luxury hotels... Which makes the mystery of her celibacy even thicker for everyone. She has, moreover, a substantial stock of condoms, which she makes Makoto benefit from as soon as he has a girlfriend. It is also impossible to determine whether Kyouko has sexual experience or not.

It is implied several times (when she is drunk) that she has a crush and/or a great sexual attraction for Makoto, having already once dragged him into bed with her to hug him like a pillow on the day he arrived in her place and by seducing him in a VERY sensual AND suggestive way.
She never remembers what she did when she was drunk, but Makoto is not entirely convinced about it.
Makoto has already had some "accidents" when she starts to annoy him by hugging him against her (generous breasts) half naked when she is drunk, but this is something she must never know.
Kyouko is mentioned in Ai Kiss and she is not in town and she left Maju in charge for the time being.

He flirts with every pretty girl he meets.

Youta is an extremophile in terms of women, loving "mature" women like Kyouko or Arisa while being engaged to his childhood friend, who is 5 years old...

親友でもあり、またまどかのクラスメイトでもある。
